title: Demonic Path Summons
next_chapter_hook: When that familiar pressure descended once more, Chen Ji knew the Demonic Path Commander's patience had run dry—and this time, he would witness firsthand another branch of his destiny.

text.content: As Chen Tianming's final words flickered out like a dying candle in the void, the burning sensation in Chen Ji's chest grew even more intense, as if a flame was spreading through his internal organs. The Tianji Record's warning had never been so frantic—golden characters danced wildly in his mind, constantly cycling through words like 'Heaven's Eye,' 'Watching,' and 'Detected.'

Chen Ji knelt on one knee, one hand clutching his chest, the other bracing against the ground. He could feel the Tianji Record fragment trembling, like a child instinctively terrified of something massive. This fear even infected him—if even an ancient relic like the Tianji Record was so wary, how could a mere Foundation Building cultivator like himself possibly resist?

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji... have you finally sensed it?" A voice pierced through the void, carrying a hint of mockery. "That gaze has never left you since the moment you activated the Tianji Record. You thought you were the one plotting against the world, but you were unaware you had already become the most conspicuous piece on the chessboard."

text.content: Chen Ji looked up sharply to see a jet-black fissure tear open in the void. The aura emanating from it was utterly unlike the warmth of the Tianji Record—pure demonic energy, so concentrated it nearly solidified. Then, a figure slowly emerged from the fissure, each step striking at Chen Ji's heart.

As the figure fully emerged from the fissure, Chen Ji's pupils constricted. The same features, the same contours, even the precise angles of the brows and eyes were identical. The only difference lay in the temperament—Chen Ji was reserved like an ancient deep well, while the newcomer blazed like fierce fire beneath the scorching sun, with pride and disdain for all beneath his brow.

dialogue.content: "What, scared by your own face?" The newcomer's lips curved into an amused smile. "I've waited three hundred years for this day. Three hundred years—do you know what that felt like? Being discarded, being used as a tool, being treated as a chess piece ready to be sacrificed at any moment... just like you."

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander—or perhaps he should be called 'the other Chen Ji'—walked closer with each step, bringing an overwhelming pressure like a mountain collapsing and the sea roaring. His demonic energy resonated with Chen Ji's Tianji Record power, producing a strange harmony. Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record in his chest trembling violently, as if caught between exultation and lamentation.

"Twin Fates bound by destiny," the Demonic Path Commander's voice echoed through the empty void. "When the Tianji Record split, it divided the complete prophetic power into two. One half was left to you—the legitimate inheritor bearing Heaven's Will; the other was given to me—the Heavenly Way's outcast, the criminal of the Demonic Path."

choice.prompt: Facing the Demonic Path Commander who shared his very face, Chen Ji had to make a choice.

choices.description: Pretend to be persuaded while secretly investigating the Demonic Path Commander's weaknesses and true intentions, seeking an opportunity to break the deadlock.
choices.visible_cost: Must endure the Demonic Path Commander's scrutiny and testing
choices.visible_reward: Acquire key intelligence, possibly uncover the secrets of the Twin Fates
choices.risk_hint: If seen through, it will utterly enrage the Demonic Path Commander

text.content: Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, his expression bearing just the right amount of shock and wavering. He lowered his eyes, as if processing this earth-shattering truth. "So... you came to me, wanting me to help you break this ancient chess game?" His voice trembled slightly, perfectly playing the role of one caught off guard.

choices.description: No matter the threats, never surrender self-awareness. Use the Tianji Record fragment as a trump card to directly challenge the Demonic Path Commander's pressure.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Demonic Path Commander, triggering direct conflict
choices.visible_reward: Display backbone and determination, possibly gaining unexpected assistance
choices.risk_hint: The vast disparity in strength makes direct conflict extremely dangerous

text.content: Chen Ji lifted his head sharply, a cold gleam flashing in his eyes. "Surrender my self-awareness?" He scoffed. "Do you think three hundred years could make you forget who you are? Even if destiny split us in two, I am Chen Ji—not anyone's subordinate."

choices.description: Avoid answering any questions directly, use various excuses to delay, secretly attempt to activate more functions of the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: May arouse suspicion from the Demonic Path Commander
choices.visible_reward: If successfully activating the Tianji Record, it may change the situation
choices.risk_hint: Abnormal fluctuations of the Tianji Record may attract the attention of the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. Instead, he put on an expression of painful struggle, pressing his temples as he murmured, 'Wait... let me think... this all came too suddenly.' In reality, his divine consciousness was frantically probing deep into the Tianji Record, searching for a way to break the impasse.

dialogue.content: 'Do not rush to make a decision,' the Demonic Path Commander shook his head slightly, his expression carrying an almost genuine tone. 'You think I'm trying to harm you? No, I am giving you a chance. Look at your current situation—the Heavenly Eye has already set its sights on you, the entire Tianqing Sect watches with hungry eyes, and even that old Ling Yuan is plotting in the shadows. Do you really think a waste like you at Foundation Building stage can hold out for long?'

text.content: Chen Ji gazed quietly at the other party, a faint, barely perceptible smile suddenly curling at the corner of his lips. This smile made the Demonic Path Commander frown slightly—he saw something unsettling in this face identical to his own.

'What are you laughing at?' The Demonic Path Commander's voice chilled. 'You think I'm joking? The attention of the Heavenly Eye, have you felt it? That sensation of being gripped by an invisible hand around the throat—it's familiar, isn't it?' He stepped forward, demonic energy growing even denser. 'This is the curse of heaven upon us twins—forever living on its chessboard, forever unable to escape the game.'

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Commander pressed closer relentlessly, forcing Chen Ji to respond:

choices.description: Since you are twin fates, why did one walk the Demonic Path while the other walks the righteous path? There must be hidden secrets in this.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Demonic Path Commander
choices.visible_reward: May extract more secrets about the Twin Fates
choices.risk_hint: If the core secrets are touched, it may trigger uncontrollable consequences

text.content: Chen Ji stared directly into the other's eyes and said in a deep voice, 'Since we are two sides of the same coin, why did you walk the path of darkness? The Tianji Record within me has never guided me toward evil.' This core-piercing question caused a crack to appear in the Demonic Path Commander's expression.

choices.description: Deliberately reveal that you know about the other party's connection with Ling Yuan, attempting to disrupt their rhythm and create negotiating leverage.
choices.visible_reward: May cause the Demonic Path Commander to reassess Chen Ji's threat level
choices.risk_hint: If the other party was already prepared, it may backfire

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed. 'The old Ling Yuan... no, what should I call him? The old Tianqing Sect Master, or your guide?' The Demonic Path Commander's pupils contracted sharply. Chen Ji knew he had guessed correctly—between these two, there was indeed some unspeakable connection.

choices.description: Not refusing cooperation, but discussing the possibility of equal collaboration while preserving self-awareness.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as showing weakness
choices.visible_reward: If successful, may gain a powerful ally
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander may not be willing to accept equal terms

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his expression calm. "Cooperation is possible, but with one condition—each of us maintains our independent consciousness. The Eye of Heavenly Dao is our common enemy, but I refuse to be anyone's puppet." His aura at this moment actually faintly rivaled that of the Demonic Path commander.

Just as the tension reached a breaking point, the Demonic Path commander suddenly threw his head back in laughter. That laughter carried three parts madness, three parts desolation, and four parts of an inexplicable relief. "Truly worthy of me..." He wiped away the tears formed from laughter at the corners of his eyes. "Three hundred years, and finally I've encountered a version of myself that's somewhat interesting."

dialogue.content: "Enough, enough," the Demonic Path commander waved his hand. "Since you wish to know, I'll tell you some of the past. When the Tianji Record split back then, it wasn't just the power that was divided—we also split our 'Fate Matrix.' You inherited the 'Bright Matrix' destined by Heaven's mandate, destined to become a righteous path leader; while I inherited the 'Dark Matrix' abandoned by Heaven, destined to wallow in darkness. This is our greatest difference, and also our greatest commonality."

text.content: Chen Ji listened quietly, but his mind was rapidly calculating. The Tianji Record Fragment did contain scattered mentions of 'Fate Matrix,' but no one had ever truly deciphered them. If what the Demonic Path commander said was true, it meant his relationship with the other was far more complex than imagined—not simple opposition or cooperation, but some deeper level of entanglement.

"Moreover," the Demonic Path commander's voice suddenly dropped lower, "do you think it was coincidence that Old Man Ling Yuan took you as his disciple back then? Do you think it was accident that the Tianji Record Fragment fell into your hands?" He gazed meaningfully at Chen Ji. "No, from the very beginning, both you and I have been pieces on his chessboard. He just never expected that the pieces would grow and develop their own will."

These words poured like a basin of cold water over Chen Ji's head. He had always thought he was the one plotting for the world, never realizing he had been calculated and schemed against from the very start. The benevolent face of Ling Yuan surfaced in Chen Ji's mind, and he suddenly felt nauseated—this old fox, his acting was simply too good.

dialogue.content: "Therefore," the Demonic Path commander stepped forward, close enough to Chen Ji, "my proposal is—this, you and I join forces, first eliminate this old thing Ling Yuan, then deal with that Eye of Heavenly Dao. As long as we break the existing chess game, we can obtain true freedom. As for what comes after..." He paused. "We can discuss that later."

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path commander proposed a cooperation to jointly deal with Ling Yuan, and Chen Ji had to make a final decision:

choices.description: First join forces against Ling Yuan, deal with what comes after when it comes. The enemy of my enemy is my friend, even if this friend looks exactly like me.
choices.visible_cost: May draw fire upon oneself and be drawn into a greater whirlpool
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Demonic Path commander as a powerful ally
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path commander's true intentions remain unclear

text.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then finally extended his hand: "Old Man Ling Yuan, I've wanted to deal with him for a long time. Since you share this intention, let's temporarily join forces—but remember, I can withdraw at any time." The Demonic Path commander clasped his hand, and two completely opposite auras unexpectedly produced a strange fusion at this moment.

choices.description: Regardless of what Ling Yuan is like, at least for now we cannot get too close to the Demonic Path. Once stained with the Demonic Path's stench, it can never be washed clean.
choices.visible_cost: Lose a potential powerful ally, and may create an enemy
choices.visible_reward: Maintain a clean stance, preserving more room for choice
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path commander is unlikely to take this lying down

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, shaking his head: "Ling Yuan's matters, I'll resolve myself. But joining forces with you..." He paused. "The Demonic Path is the Demonic Path, Chen Ji has not yet fallen to the point of needing to fraternize with demonic monsters." As the words fell, he turned and left, his back view resolute.

choices.description: Can cooperate, but require the Demonic Path commander to first prove his sincerity—for example, by handing over key intelligence about Ling Yuan.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as pushing one's luck
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence while maintaining the initiative
choices.risk_hint: If conditions are too excessive, negotiations may break down

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer immediately. Instead, he asked back, "What evidence do you have for what you've just said?" A slight smile crossed his face. "Anyone can make empty claims. If you're truly sincere, show me something real." The Demon Path Commander's eyes lit up, and there was more appreciation in the way he looked at Chen Ji.

Just as Chen Ji waited for a response, an old yet majestic voice suddenly rang out from the Void. "Interesting, truly interesting." The voice seemed to come from all directions, yet also from the depths of Chen Ji's heart. "Two split pieces, actually trying to join forces against the Chess Player?"

Chen Ji and the Demon Path Commander both changed color. This voice — it was Ling Yuan! A golden fissure suddenly tore open in the Void, echoing the black crack from which the Demon Commander had arrived. A figure in cyan robes stepped slowly out from the golden fissure — it was precisely the former Patriarch of the Tianqing Sect, Ling Yuan.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan looked around at the two of them, his smile growing even more amused. "Twin children of fate — one walking the righteous path, the other entering the Demonic Path; one chosen by the Tianji Record, one abandoned by the Tianji Record... What a perfect arrangement. But do you really think this was my scheme?" He laughed uproariously toward the heavens. "No — this game was set in motion the moment you were born. And I... I simply turned their plan to my advantage."

text.content: Chen Ji stared fixedly at Ling Yuan, but his mind was racing at lightning speed. This old fox — from the very beginning, he had known about Chen Ji's relationship with the Demon Commander, yet had pretended complete ignorance, secretly observing their reactions. This kind of restraint and calculation was truly terrifying.

"However," Ling Yuan's tone shifted, "I didn't come here today to cause trouble for you." He looked at Chen Ji meaningfully. "Chen Ji, do you know what the true secret of the Tianji Record is?" Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression remained unchanged. Ling Yuan smiled and said: "It's not some prophetic divine artifact — it's a key. A key to opening the 'Heavenly Dao Imprisonment.'"

dialogue.content: "The ancient Chess Player within you owes me a life," Ling Yuan's voice suddenly turned icy cold. "Three hundred years ago, to escape the pursuit of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, he split his soul into two halves — one left for you, one left for him." He pointed at the Demon Commander. "And I... am merely the guardian he chose. Unfortunately, he never imagined I would have ambitions of my own."

text.content: Chen Ji felt as if something exploded in his mind. Mr. Mo — that mysterious existence dwelling as a remnant soul on the first page of the Tianji Record, was actually the originator of all this? He had always believed Mr. Mo was his helper, was the chessboard guardian Chen Xuan had left behind, never expecting that the other party had been concealing things from the very beginning.

"Therefore," Ling Yuan stepped forward, his oppressive aura suddenly intensifying, "today I come to reclaim what belongs to me." He extended his hand, pointing at Chen Ji's chest. "The Tianji Record Fragment — hand it over." At this moment, Chen Ji finally understood that whether it was himself or the Demon Commander, in Ling Yuan's eyes they were merely chess pieces. And now, the endgame had arrived.

However, the moment Ling Yuan drew close, the Demon Commander suddenly stepped in front of Chen Ji. His demonic energy collided violently with Ling Yuan's oppressive aura, stirring up a fierce wind. "Old Ling Yuan," the Demon Commander grinned wickedly, "if you want to touch him, you'd better ask my Demonic Blade first!"

Chen Ji stared blankly at the figure blocking his path. This person who looked exactly like him was now protecting him as if he were guarding his own flesh-and-blood brother. Twin children of fate — perhaps from the depths of their bloodline, they shared an unbreakable bond.

Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, his gaze toward the Demon Commander now carrying more playful interest. "Interesting. A fragmented soul piece, yet still able to produce a protective instinct? It seems the power of the Tianji Record is more miraculous than I imagined." He suddenly burst into laughter. "Very well, very well, let's end it here for today." His figure began to fade. "Chen Ji, take good care of your Tianji Record. The day you gather all the fragments, I will come for it again. Then—" his voice gradually faded into the distance, "you will personally offer everything upon the altar."

After Ling Yuan departed, only Chen Ji and the Demon Commander remained in the Void. The Demon Commander turned around, his gaze toward Chen Ji carrying a complex mixture of emotions. "The Mr. Mo within you," he said heavily, "owes me a life." Chen Ji frowned: "What do you mean?" The Demon Commander sneered: "Three hundred years ago, he created me specifically to be your shield against calamities. I am his discarded piece, while you are his favored one."

Chen Ji fell silent. He remembered Mr. Mo's expressions of wanting to speak yet hesitating, remembering how the other party always only revealed "what needed to be said." So from the very beginning, the master he had trusted had been arranging things for this very day. What exactly was the so-called chessboard guardian guarding? Chen Ji's destiny, or the completeness of the Tianji Record?

"However," the Demon Commander suddenly changed his tone, "I don't care about being a favorite or a discarded piece. I only care about one thing — shattering this ancient chess game." He looked at Chen Ji. "You and I are both chess pieces, yet both share the sorrow of being pieces. Since Ling Yuan has revealed his identity, then he is our common enemy. The enemy of my enemy..." He extended his hand. "...is a friend."

Chen Ji looked at that hand, his heart filled with countless emotions. He knew this could be another trap, or perhaps the only chance to change his destiny. The Tianji Record in his chest pulsed warmly, as if urging him to make a decision. Should the debt Mr. Mo owed be repaid by him?

At this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly trembled violently. An old voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind: "Child... I'm sorry..." It was Mr. Mo's voice. Chen Ji clutched his chest suddenly, able to sense that Mr. Mo's remnant soul was separating from the Tianji Record in some way — as if Ling Yuan's appearance had triggered some self-destruct program.

"No!" Chen Ji growled low. He instinctively wanted to stop it, but Mr. Mo's voice had already grown fainter: "Remember... the true secret of the Tianji Record... is not in prophecy... but in..." The voice stopped abruptly. Mr. Mo's remnant soul had completely dispersed.

Chen Ji stood there in a daze, feeling the empty void in his chest. Mr. Mo — this existence that had accompanied him through countless days and nights — had simply vanished like that? He hadn't even had the chance to ask that most important question: what exactly was the complete secret of the Tianji Record?

The Demon Commander watched all this quietly, a complex expression flickering in his eyes. "It seems," he said softly, "that Ling Yuan was right. Mr. Mo did leave some kind of backup within you. And now, this backup has been triggered by himself." He shook his head. "The ancient Chess Player... ultimately underestimated Ling Yuan's ambition."

Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Mr. Mo's disappearance pained him greatly, but this was absolutely not the time for self-pity. Ling Yuan had revealed his identity, Mr. Mo's secrets remained unsolved, and the entanglements of the twin children of fate were only beginning — and he must find his own path in this even more complex grand chess game.

He raised his head and looked at the Demon Commander. "Cooperation is possible," his voice regained its calmness, "but I have conditions." The Demon Commander raised an eyebrow: "Speak." Chen Ji said word by word: "First, each of us operates independently without interfering with the other; second, all actions must be coordinated in advance; third—" he paused, "when everything is over, I want to know exactly how the life Mr. Mo owed you came about."

The Demon Commander stared at Chen Ji for a moment, then suddenly burst into hearty laughter. "Excellent!" He heavily slapped Chen Ji's shoulder. "Worthy of being like me! Three hundred years, and I've finally encountered someone who commands my genuine respect — or rather, another self." Two pairs of equally profound eyes met, and at this moment, the twin children of fate reached a subtle understanding.

However, just as the two were about to part, the Demon Commander suddenly stopped in his tracks. He didn't turn around, only leaving behind a sentence: "By the way, there's something I forgot to mention — your sister, Chen Nian, she's still alive." Chen Ji's whole body shuddered. "She's in the Holy Sect," the Demon Commander's voice drifted over faintly, "and that place... is precisely Ling Yuan's Forbidden Grounds." The moment his words fell, his figure had already vanished into the Void's fissure.

Chen Nian — this name was like a thunderclap exploding in Chen Ji's mind. His sister who had been missing for many years, the sister who had been taken by the Holy Sect as a "Heavenly Fate Lock Key," was actually still alive? And the place she was in turned out to be Ling Yuan's Forbidden Grounds? Was all this coincidence, or was it fate?

Chen Ji stood in the vast Void, the Tianji Record Fragment on his chest had regained its calm. Mo Xiansheng's departure filled him with grief, the truth of the twin fates shocked him, Ling Yuan's ambition made him wary, and Chen Nian's news ignited a new flame in his heart. All these clues intertwined, pointing toward an increasingly clear answer—

Ling Yuan—the seemingly benevolent old Sect Master—was actually the true Chess Player behind everything. He had been arranging pieces for three hundred years, treating Chen Ji, the Demonic Path Commander, and even Mo Xiansheng as mere chess pieces. Now the chess game had entered the middle game, and Chen Ji had to break the current balance to find a way to turn the tide.

Chen Ji slowly clenched his fist. He recalled Mo Xiansheng's final words—"The true secret of the Tianji Record lies not in prophecy, but in..." What? The answer might be hidden within those unsealed Tianji Record Fragments. To gather all the fragments, he must grow stronger, must find more allies, must carve out a path that belongs to him alone within this ancient chess game.

Chen Ji turned and gazed toward the Tianqing Sect. Ling Yuan had departed, yet his shadow seemed to envelop the entire world. He knew from this day forward, there would be no room for negotiation between himself and Ling Yuan. Either you die, or I perish—this was the destined outcome between a Chess Player and a chess piece.

When that familiar pressure descended once more, Chen Ji knew the Demonic Path Commander's patience had run out—and this time, he would witness another branch of his destiny. Mo Xiansheng's departure had taken many answers, yet it also made him more清醒地：in this ancient chess game, the only one he could rely on was himself.

In the Void, the Tianji Record Fragments emitted a faint glow. Chen Ji gently brushed across those ancient inscriptions, and resolve had formed in his heart. No matter how perilous the path ahead, he would find Chen Nian, would uncover the secrets of the Tianji Record, would make Ling Yuan pay the price. This was his obsession as Chen Ji, and also the starting point of his defiance against destiny.
The night wind brushed past, and Chen Ji's silhouette gradually vanished into the Void. The next storm was approaching, and he, was already prepared.
